changelog: v0.4.2: Fixed speech synthesis audio on Meta Quest 3: 1) Auto-detected that Meta Quest Browser contains 0 native speech synthesis voices and auto-routed to on-device Neural TTS (WASM); 2) Populated Voice dropdown with clear active Neural Voice option instead of blank box; 3) Replaced WebGPU requirement in Neural TTS with pure CPU WebAssembly (WASM) to match Whisper; 4) Switched audio playback to dual HTML5 WAV audio + Web Audio for reliable Quest 3 headset speaker output; 5) Multi-tiered voice fallback ensuring audio is always audible.
